verses.english: Linked Discourses 7.15
2. Lay Followers
Stuck-Up
At Sāvatthī.

verses.pali: Tena kho pana samayena mānatthaddho nāma brāhmaṇo sāvatthiyaṁ paṭivasati.
verses.english: Now at that time a brahmin named Stuck-Up was residing in Sāvatthī.

verses.pali: So neva mātaraṁ abhivādeti, na pitaraṁ abhivādeti, na ācariyaṁ abhivādeti, na jeṭṭhabhātaraṁ abhivādeti.
verses.english: He didn’t bow to his mother or father, his tutor, or his oldest brother.

verses.pali: Tena kho pana samayena bhagavā mahatiyā parisāya parivuto dhammaṁ deseti.
verses.english: Now, at that time the Buddha was teaching Dhamma, surrounded by a large assembly.
Then Stuck-Up thought,

verses.pali: “ayaṁ kho samaṇo gotamo mahatiyā parisāya parivuto dhammaṁ deseti.
verses.english: “The ascetic Gotama is teaching Dhamma, surrounded by a large assembly.
Why don’t I approach him?

verses.pali: Sace maṁ samaṇo gotamo ālapissati, ahampi taṁ ālapissāmi.
verses.english: If he speaks to me, I’ll speak to him.

verses.pali: No ce maṁ samaṇo gotamo ālapissati, ahampi nālapissāmī”ti.
verses.english: But if he doesn’t speak, neither will I.”

verses.pali: Atha kho mānatthaddho brāhmaṇo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā tuṇhībhūto ekamantaṁ aṭṭhāsi.
verses.english: Then the brahmin Stuck-Up went up to the Buddha, and stood silently to one side.
But the Buddha didn’t speak to him.
Then Stuck-Up thought,

verses.pali: “nāyaṁ samaṇo gotamo kiñci jānātī”ti tatova puna nivattitukāmo ahosi.
verses.english: “This ascetic Gotama knows nothing!” And he wanted to go back from there right away.

verses.pali: Atha kho bhagavā mānatthaddhassa brāhmaṇassa cetasā cetoparivitakkamaññāya mānatthaddhaṁ brāhmaṇaṁ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi:
verses.english: Then the Buddha, knowing Stuck-Up’s train of thought, addressed him in verse:
“It’s not good to foster conceit
if you want what’s good for you, brahmin.
You should foster the goal
which brought you here.”
Then Stuck-Up thought,

verses.pali: “cittaṁ me samaṇo gotamo jānātī”ti tattheva bhagavato pādesu sirasā nipatitvā bhagavato pādāni mukhena ca paricumbati pāṇīhi ca parisambāhati, nāmañca sāveti:
verses.english: “The ascetic Gotama knows my mind!” He bowed with his head at the Buddha’s feet, caressing them and covering them with kisses, and pronounced his name:
“Worthy Gotama, I am Stuck-Up! I am Stuck-Up!”

verses.pali: Atha kho sā parisā abbhutavittajātā ahosi:
verses.english: Then that assembly was stunned:
“Oh lord, how incredible, how amazing!

verses.pali: Ayañhi mānatthaddho brāhmaṇo neva mātaraṁ abhivādeti, na pitaraṁ abhivādeti, na ācariyaṁ abhivādeti, na jeṭṭhabhātaraṁ abhivādeti;
verses.english: This brahmin Stuck-Up doesn’t bow to his mother or father, his tutor, or his oldest brother.

verses.pali: atha ca pana samaṇe gotame evarūpaṁ paramanipaccakāraṁ karotī”ti.
verses.english: Yet he shows such utmost deference to the ascetic Gotama!”

verses.pali: Atha kho bhagavā mānatthaddhaṁ brāhmaṇaṁ etadavoca:
verses.english: Then the Buddha said to the brahmin Stuck-Up,
“Enough, brahmin. Get up, and take your own seat.
For your mind has confidence in me.”

verses.pali: Atha kho mānatthaddho brāhmaṇo sake āsane nisīditvā bhagavantaṁ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi:
verses.english: Then Stuck-Up took his seat and said to the Buddha:
“Regarding whom should you not be conceited?
Who should you respect?
Who should you esteem?
Who is it good to venerate properly?”
“Your mother and father,
and also your oldest brother,
with tutor as fourth.
Regarding these you should not be conceited.
They are who you should respect.
They are who you should esteem.
And they’re who it’s good to venerate properly.
And when with bent knee, not stiff with conceit,
show supreme reverence for
the perfected ones—cooled,
their task complete, free of defilements.”

verses.pali: Evaṁ vutte, mānatthaddho brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṁ etadavoca:
verses.english: When he had spoken, the brahmin Stuck-Up said to the Buddha,
“Excellent, worthy Gotama …

verses.pali: upāsakaṁ maṁ bhavaṁ gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṁ saraṇaṁ gatan”ti.
verses.english: From this day forth, may the worthy Gotama remember me as a lay follower who has gone for refuge for life.”
